## 👨‍💻 About Me

I am a **Senior Mobile App Developer** with a strong focus on **React Native** and **On-Device AI**. I specialize in engineering clean, scalable architectures and pushing the boundaries of what mobile devices can do entirely offline. 

- 🚀 **Currently Building:** [Vaani](#-featured-project-vaani) — an offline, privacy-first AI chat application for Android featuring on-device LLM inference.
- 💡 **Core Expertise:** React Native, Expo, Clean Architecture, Mobile App Performance Optimization, On-Device AI/ML Inference (`llama.rn`).
- 🎯 **Recent Wins:** 
  - Reduced AI response latency from 1-2 minutes down to 15-25 seconds.
  - Architected robust OTA pipelines with runtime fingerprinting.
  - Successfully debugged and resolved critical production RAM/memory leaks.

## 🔮 Featured Project: Vaani

<div align="center">
  <img src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/19d32f4b-0fb1-42e1-81b4-f717536e83f4" alt="Vaani Preview" width="600" style="border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 8px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);" />
</div>

<br/>

**Vaani** is a privacy-first, fully offline AI chat application for Android. It operates with **zero servers** and **zero data collection**, running inference entirely on-device.

- **Stack:** `Expo SDK 56` | `llama.rn` | `Zustand` | `Clean Architecture` | `Reanimated + SVG`
- **Key Features:**
  - 🎙️ **Offline voice input & TTS:** Integrated Text-To-Speech with buffered token streaming.
  - ⚡ **Arm64-v8a optimization:** Extremely fast local LLM inference optimizations.
  - ✨ **Custom Animations:** Micro-animations (e.g., dynamic "breathing orb") built with Reanimated & SVG.
  - ⚙️ **Seamless Parity:** EAS ↔ Local build parity via custom Expo config plugins.
